Blackwing pencils are ideal for illustrators and writers who prefer a soft, dark line. These Natural pencils are crafted from incense cedar wood with a clear matte finish, letting you appreciate the natural color and pattern of the wood. They feature gold imprinted writing on the barrels. The unique rectangular gray eraser can be extended as it wears down from use, and also pops out completely from the pencil body for replacement. The eraser is latex free, and replacement erasers are available in a variety of colors.

Blackwing pencils differ in the softness of the graphite core, which can be felt while writing and drawing. These pencils feature an extra-firm core that holds a sharp point without sacrificing dark lines. 

These pencils were previously known as Palomino Blackwing Pencils.

## Customer Reviews

- Thought I'd add my two...

February 13, 2020

Thought I'd add my two cents to the conversation. I have mixed thoughts on this pencil. The finish is nice for a natural-wood pencil. Nice and smooth without obscuring the wood tones. However, I do miss the small amount of weight and substance which seems to be added by the painted finish. Feels a bit "too light" to me, and unbalanced with the chunky ferule/eraser combo on the other end. As for the writing experience, it's decently dark for such a hard core. However, it feels incredibly scratchy and not at all like the experience of the 602. Between the finish and writing experience, one wonders how it's even in the same lineup as the rest of the smooth, dark Blackwings.

13 people found this helpful

Scotty A See all my reviews

September 5, 2019 Verified Purchase

Needs quality control. The pencils are wonderful, but such an expensive box of pencils I expect all of them to be in good quality. One was split through, a few others had wood knotches in them. Felt a bit like I got a box of discards. 

12 people found this helpful

Nichole B See all my reviews
- These pencils are smoothest...

July 11, 2019 Verified Purchase

These pencils are smoothest pencils I have ever owned. The weight of this pencil feels very nice due to the added weight to the end of the pencil because of the metal eraser clip and the LONG eraser. The pencil sharpens very nice and has never broken during sharpening. The wood even feels smooth while sharping. Another positive thing about this pencil is that natural wood "look" of this pencil is made very nice and does not look like I shaved the yellow paint off a Ticonderoga pencil. The pencil holds its just as much as a normal HB pencil but writes very smooth and even darker. This pencil even under the lightest of pressure, writes darker than any HB pencil I have ever used. Compared to the most famous Ticonderoga pencil, the Ticonderoga pencil feels as if you are scratching your nail on a chalkboard when compared to the rich and smooth feeling of the Palomino Blackwing pencil. Not to even mention how aesthetically pleasing this pencil looks when compared to the yellow and green colors of the Ticonderoga pencil. I usually share my stationary products with fellow school mates, but the second I used this pencil, I knew that I wanted to keep every single piece of graphite of this pencil to myself. If this pencil was marked at twice the price, I will not hesitate to buy this pack of pencil again. All in all a 100/5.

9 people found this helpful

YellowPickles21 See all my reviews
- Sharpens to a VERY sharp,...

December 2, 2019 Verified Purchase

Sharpens to a VERY sharp, fine, long lasting point. Not gritty or fragile. This is my “go to” for ridiculously fine detail work. (I prefer the standard Blackwing for marathon writing and the Pearl for most everything though it is softer). Overall if you like pencils/graphite a lot, it is true that Palomino Blackwings are noticeably smoother and are a different experience than a plain old yellow #2. (In fairness I haven’t tried Tombow or Uni pencils as of this writing)

5 people found this helpful

MrTomRN See all my reviews
- Blackwing erasers continue...

April 2, 2021 Verified Purchase

Blackwing erasers continue to suck, but the graphite makes up for it. I fell in love with Blackwing's extra-firm graphite when they originally created with for Vol. 24 and am thrilled that they decided to make it part of a regular line. (I was down to one box of 24s!) This is my go-to pencil for reasonably dark lines that don't need re-sharpening every two seconds. Just...pick up a few Tombow erasers while you're at it.

# About this item

- PENCILS WITH HERITAGE: First created in the 1930s, Blackwing built a following that included author John Steinbeck and Chuck Jones, who proudly used them to create Bugs Bunny. When they were discontinued in the ‘90s, devotees paid as much as $40 a pencil. In 2010, we revived the Blackwing brand for a new generation of writers, musicians, and artists.
- PERFECT FOR ILLUSTRATORS & CALLIGRAPHERS: With our extra firm Japanese graphite core, Blackwing Natural pencils are perfect for illustrators, and UI/UX designers. Add our pencils to your office or school supplies so you’ll always have a reliable writing utensil nearby. Use it for a line that is slightly firmer than the Blackwing 602. No excessive sharpening required!
- UNIQUE ICONIC DESIGN: Blackwing’s unique and iconic rectangular erasers are synonymous with quality. Each of our pencils features a specially designed ferrule, allowing you to extend or replace the eraser when it gets worn down. Our pencils make an excellent gift for men and women who like drawing or taking hand-written notes. Keep these pencils at your work desk or use them to sketch on the go.
- COMMITMENT TO QUALITY: Blackwing Natural pencils are made with the finest premium materials in the world. The exposed Incense-cedar wooden barrel, with a subtle clear matte finish, comes from California. The extra-firm, high-quality graphite comes from Japan and is ideal for note-taking, marking, and sketching. Our cool pencils are a sophisticated addition to any stationery kit.
- HOW WE GIVE BACK: A portion of the sales from all Blackwing products benefit the Blackwing Foundation, which funds and develops arts and music education at the K – 12 level. Your purchase helps provide, among other things, the instruction, learning environment, and instruments children need to participate in the Little Kids’ Rock Modern Band Program.

# Blackwing Natural Box of 12

 Sale price$49.95

The Blackwing Natural features an exposed Incense-cedar barrel with a subtle clear matte finish and Blackwing's popular extra-firm graphite. Every Blackwing Natural features a gold imprint, grey eraser and the iconic square Blackwing ferrule. Blackwing Natural pencils come in a 12-pack gift box that doubles as a pencil cup.

+14169217131

 Why Laywine's 

- Trusted since 1987 — Family-owned and run by people who genuinely love what they sell.
- Free shipping over $75 — Across Canada via UPS, with lower thresholds for Correspondents' Club members.
- Expert advice in store — Visit us at 25 Bellair Street in Yorkville, Toronto and try pens before you buy.
- Free virtual personal shopping — Can't make it in? Book a free one-on-one appointment and get expert advice from home.
- Secure checkout — Shop with confidence.

 Shipping 

We aim to dispatch all orders within 2 business days. You'll receive a shipping confirmation with tracking once your order is on its way.

## Canada

Standard shipping Shipping rates are calculated at checkout. Correspondents' Club members receive free standard shipping via UPS when their order total, after any points redemption, is over:

- $75 for Visitors
- $50 for Members
- $25 for Residents
- any amount for Fellows

Residents and Fellows also receive free expedited shipping on orders over $100. Membership is free to join. See our Correspondents' Club Terms for how tiers work.

Same-day delivery Same-day delivery is available within 30km of 25 Bellair Street, Toronto, seven days a week. Orders placed by 11am are delivered the same day; orders placed after 11am are delivered the following day. A flat fee of $16.95 is applied automatically at checkout. Correspondents' Club members receive a $16.95 discount on same-day delivery.

Good Foot Delivery If you are within the Good Foot Delivery catchment area, you will also see this as a delivery option at checkout. Good Foot is a Toronto-based social enterprise that employs autistic and neurodivergent adults as couriers. We're proud to support their work.

## United States & International

We ship via UPS Global Checkout. All duties, taxes, and import fees are calculated and paid at checkout, so there are no surprise charges on delivery.

## Discounts and shipping

Promotional discount codes cannot be combined with shipping discounts, including Correspondents' Club free standard shipping, free expedited shipping, and the same-day delivery discount. If a promotional discount code is applied to your order, the code takes effect and shipping is charged at the standard rate.

This does not apply to loyalty points redemptions, which can be used together with shipping discounts. See our Terms of Service for full details.

## Oversized items

Some items incur an additional flat-rate shipping fee due to their dimensions. This is applied automatically at checkout.

## Questions

Get in touch at scribble@laywines.com and we'll be happy to help.

 Returns & Exchanges 

Returns & Refunds

EU Right of Withdrawal If you are located in the European Union, you have the right to withdraw from your order within 14 days of receiving the last item, without giving any reason. To exercise this right, start your request through your customer account at 

https://account.laywines.com

 within the 14-day window. You then have a further 14 days to return the item. We will refund you within 14 days of receiving the returned goods, including the standard outbound shipping cost you paid (upgraded shipping costs are not refunded). Return shipping costs are your responsibility unless the item is faulty or not as described.

The following items are exempt from the right of withdrawal: opened ink cartridges, pen refills, and bottled ink (sealed goods that are not suitable for return due to health or hygiene reasons once opened); personalized or custom-made items.

Standard Returns & Exchanges

We accept returns within 14 days of purchase and exchanges within 30 days, provided items are unused, in original condition, and in original packaging with proof of purchase.

Non-Returnable Items

Opened ink cartridges, pen refills, bottled ink, perishable goods, dated products, and gift cards cannot be returned.

Sale Items

Items discounted 25% or more are final sale and cannot be refunded or exchanged.

Refunds

Once your return is received and inspected, we'll notify you by email. Approved refunds are processed to your original payment method within a few business days.

Exchanges

To request an exchange, email scribble@laywines.com before sending your item to:

Laywine's 25 Bellair Street Toronto ON M5R 3L3 Canada

Return Shipping

Return shipping costs are the customer's responsibility. For items valued over $75, we recommend a trackable service as we cannot guarantee receipt otherwise.
